title: Editing Access Policies for Global Rules and Policy Groups

blocks.text: This feature is in limited availability. To learn more, contact Zscaler Support.
To edit an access policy global rule or policy group:

blocks.item: Go to Private Access > Policy > Access Policy.
Locate the global rule or the policy group you want to edit, and click the Edit icon.

blocks.text: If you only want to change an access policy rule's place in the Rule Order, you can manually enter a new value on the Global Rules or Policy Groups page.

blocks.item: On the Edit Global Rule page, modify fields as necessary.
On the Edit Policy Group Rule page, modify fields as necessary.
To learn more, see Configuring Access Policies for Global Rules and Policy Groups.
